title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE GINSENG INDUSTRY ACT
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe the matters delegated by the Ginseng Industry Act and necessary matters for the enforcement thereof.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 24, 2014]

Article 1-2 (Formulation of comprehensive plans for ginseng industry) (1) If the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs intends to formulate a comprehensive plan under Article 3(1) of the Ginseng Industry Act (Hereafter in this Article, referred to as "comprehensive plan" ; and the ginseng industry act shall hereinafter be referred to as the "act"), he or she shall, in advance, hear the opinions of the Administrator of the Rural Development Administration, the heads of local governments, the heads of ginseng-related producers' organizations
  (2) Deleted. <Oct. 17, 2017>
  (3) Where a comprehensive plan must be amended due to policy changes, the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may amend the comprehensive plan. In such cases, he or she shall, in advance, hear the opinions of the Administrator of the Rural Development Administration, the heads of local governments, the heads of ginseng-related producers' organizations
  (4) When the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs formulates or amends a comprehensive plan, he or she shall publish the details thereof on the website of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.
  [This Article Added on Sep. 11, 2014]

Article 2 (Important changes to be reported by manufacturer of ginseng varieties) "Important matters prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 12(3) of the Act means any of the following subparagraphs: <Amended on Sep. 11, 2014>
  1. Trade name;
  2. Representative(s);
  3. Location of the business place or the manufacturing site;
  4. Ginseng varieties which are manufactured.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 24, 2014]

Article 3 (Types of ginseng products) "Items prescribed by Presidential Decree from among the ginseng products" in the forepart of Article 12(6) of the Act means the following items: <Amended on Dec. 12, 2023>
  1. Concentrated ginseng;
  2. Powdered ginseng;
  3. Concentrated red ginseng;
  4. Powdered red ginseng;
  5. Glyco-precipitat ginseng;
  6. White ginseng product made with at least 80% of soluble ginseng ingredients (referring to those containing at least 80 ㎎  of the ginseng-saponin per gram);
  7. Red ginseng product made with at least 80% of soluble ginseng ingredients (referring to those containing at least 70 ㎎  of the red ginseng-saponin per gram).
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 24, 2014]

Article 3-2 (Marking methods and criteria for judging of place of origin of ginseng varieties) `Article 5 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Origin Labeling of Agricultural and Fishery Products shall apply mutatis mutandis to the marking methods and criteria for judging or such of the place of origin of ginseng varieties under the latter part of Article 15(1) of the Act. <Amended on Jan. 25, 2012; Dec. 31, 2021>
  [This Article Added on Jan. 11, 2008]

Article 4 (Exception to inspection) "Cases prescribed by Presidential Decree" in the proviso to the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 17(1) of the Act means where a manufacturer or collector of ginseng varieties marks the place of origin, weight, the names of manufacturer and distributor on the red, Taegeuk, or white ginseng, or any other ginseng, and sells to a person who manufactures and processes ginseng products using such ginseng as raw materials. <Amended on Oct. 17, 2017>
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 24, 2014]

Article 5 (Facilities and manpower of self-inspection enterprise) The criteria for facilities and manpower which a person, who intends to be designated as a self-inspection enterprise pursuant to Article 17-2(1) of the Act is to be equipped with, are same as the Appendix 1.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 24, 2014]

Article 5-2 (Qualifications of inspectors) Persons who have received education for inspectors under Article 17-5(3) of the Act, among any of the following persons, shall be qualified as inspectors under Article 17-5(2) of the Act: <Amended on Jun. 30, 2016; Aug. 16, 2017; Mar. 24, 2026>
  1. Any person who has graduated (including a prospective graduate) from a junior college or higher education institution under the Higher Education Act in the field of biology, chemistry, agriculture, food engineering, nutrition, or pharmacy or who is recognized under applicable statutes and regulations as having academic qualifications equivalent or higher than such level);
  1-2. Any person holds a license to serve as a food technician, food engineer, food-industry engineer, or agrochemical technician under the National Technical Qualifications Act;
  2. Any person who has at least two years’ work experience in the field of physicochemical or food-microbial inspection at a national or public research institute, ginseng variety inspection agency provided for in Article 17(1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the "ginseng variety inspection agency"), ginseng variety manufacturing enterprise, or ginseng products manufacturing enterprise;
  3. Any person who has at least two years’ work experience in the field of quality inspection at a national agricultural products inspection institute, ginseng varieties manufacturing enterprise, ginseng variety producers' organization, or ginseng variety research institute (referring to any research institute provided for in Article 3(2) of the Act);
  4. Any person who has at least six months’ work experience in the field of quality inspection at a ginseng variety inspection agency.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 24, 2014]

Article 5-3 (Re-examination of regulation) The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall examine the appropriateness of the following matters every three years (referring to the period that ends on the day before the base date of every third year) from the base date specified in the following subparagraphs and take measures for improvement: <Amended on Sep. 11, 2014; Dec. 30, 2016>
  1. Criteria for designation as a self-inspection enterprise under Article 5: January 1, 2017;
  2. Qualifications for inspectors under Article 5-2: January 1, 2017;
  3. Deleted. <Mar. 3, 2020>
  [This Article Added on Dec. 30, 2013]

Article 6 (Imposition of administrative fines) Criteria for the imposition of administrative fines prescribed in Article 33(1) and (2) of the Act shall be as specified in Appendix 2. <Amended on Dec. 12, 2023>
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Feb. 8, 2010]

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 17242, Jun. 22, 2001>
(1) (Enforcement date) This Decree shall enter into force on July 1, 2001.
(2) (Transitional measures concerning inspection of tiny-sized ginseng) The inspection of the ginseng varieties prescribed by the Ministerial Decree of Agriculture and Forestry pursuant to subparagraph 1 of previous Article 7-2 as at the time this Decree enters into force, shall be subject to the previous provisions by not later than June 30, 2002, notwithstanding the amended provisions of Article 4.
(3) (Transitional measures concerning criteria for imposition of administrative fines) The imposition of administrative fines for offenses committed before this Decree enters into force shall be governed by the previous provisions.
(4) Omitted.
